structured_output.summary: The three Date.prototype.toLocale{,Date,Time}String changes gate on agent.intl and follow ECMA-402 steps 1-6 in order with the spec's comments. RequireInternalSlot is covered by date::this_time_value, NaN returns "Invalid Date", CreateDateTimeFormat is called on %Intl.DateTimeFormat% with the right required/defaults pairs (any/all, date/date, time/time), and FormatDateTime is applied to x. The ECMA-262 fallback is untouched when agent.intl is false. No special-casing, no swallowed errors, and no unrelated edits. The support helpers (create_date_time_format, format_date_time, date::this_time_value) are not in the diff, so I could not verify that they perform the construct without extra observable lookups; this is an unverified assumption, not a detected defect.
